A fingerprint shared with a large percentage of other visitors, not a "1 in a million" result

All test ad slots reported as blocked

blocks.html: If a site breaks after any of these tests, the full site-wide Troubleshooting Guide covers common issues, a quick flowchart, and how to whitelist a site — indexed by which part of the guide sent you there.

intro.html:
A protection you can't verify isn't a protection you can rely on. After setting up your browser, extensions, and fingerprint defenses, run the full test suite below to confirm each layer is actually doing its job.

"Trust, but verify. Five minutes of testing catches misconfigurations that would otherwise sit unnoticed for months."
